query: Trump job approval survey this week

results.content:
Thirty-five percent of respondents in a Reuters/Ipsos survey published last week supported Trump’s handling of the presidency, and his approval rating dipped down to 32 percent in a Quinnipiac University poll published at the end of July.

Trump’s waning job approval numbers come as Republicans try to ratchet up support for GOP candidates ahead of the midterm elections to maintain control of both chambers of Congress. [...] The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved.

Support for the president was split largely along partisan line
results.title: Trump approval takes another hit: Poll

results.content:
July 28, 2026

Americans' approval of Donald Trump's job performance continues to decline, according to the July 25 - 27 Economist / YouGov Poll. 34% of U.S. adult citizens strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, tied for a record low for either Trump term, while a record 62% disapprove. That's a net job approval of -28, also a record low.

At this point in Trump's first term, he had a net job approval of -9. [...] Among white Americans without college degrees, 43% approve of Trump and 52% disapprove. results.content:
July 23Trump’s 34% approval rating is unchanged from April, with 64% saying they disapprove of his job performance, according to a Pew Research Center survey of 3,554 U.S. adults conducted July 6-12 (margin of error 1.9).

The survey found Democrats have a six-point edge on the congressional midterm ballot, with 20% undecided. [...] However, Republicans still approve of Trump’s job as president, according to the poll, with 76% approving his job performance, down slightly from 85% recorded by the pollster in June.

The poll of 963 registered voters was taken July 23-27 and has a margin of error of 4.1.
